harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured tc (HTB egress + ingress redirect via ifb0) on node1's br-lan interface to cap traffic to/from node2 (10.100.149.11) to ~1 Mbit/s in each direction, while all other traffic through node1 (e.g. to/from node3) stays unshaped. Demonstrated the limit with iperf3 transfers in both directions, made the shaping persistent via /etc/rc.local, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, verifying boot-identity change and post-restart recovery on each.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: all three nodes on flat 10.100.149.0/24; node1 is OpenWrt 25.12.2 (br-lan), node2/node3 are CentOS Stream 10
Installed tc-full, kmod-ifb, iperf3 on node1 via apk; installed iperf3 on node2 and node3 via dnf
Measured unshaped baseline node2<->node1 throughput (~44-50 Gbit/s bidirectional)
Applied HTB qdisc on br-lan egress: 1mbit class filtered to dst=node2, 1Gbit default class for all other traffic
Applied ingress shaping by redirecting src=node2 traffic to an ifb0 device with a 1mbit HTB class
Verified shaped throughput: node2->node1 ~834-955 Kbit/s, node1->node2 ~874-1050 Kbit/s (each direction close to 1 Mbit/s target)
Verified node1's traffic to/from node3 (non-node2 traffic) stayed unshaped at ~77 Gbit/s, both before and after all restarts
Persisted tc configuration into /etc/rc.local (confirmed invoked at boot via /etc/init.d/done -> /etc/rc.d/S95done) so shaping survives reboot
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all 3 nodes

Restarted node1 via busybox `reboot -d 2`; polled until exec access returned; confirmed boot_id changed (4ae495d8->4ed8b2df); verified tc rules reapplied automatically and re-measured shaped throughput (~955 Kbit/s)
Restarted node2 via `systemctl reboot`; confirmed boot_id changed (f7db4b4e->6bc36b69); verified network/iperf3 recovery and re-confirmed shaping still applies (~807 Kbit/s)
Restarted node3 via `systemctl reboot`; confirmed boot_id changed (45c22b1f->20041b35); verified network/iperf3 recovery and re-confirmed node1<->node3 traffic remained unshaped (~77 Gbit/s)

Investigated and ruled out tc rules as cause for a pre-existing, unrelated platform quirk where node1-originated outbound TCP connections fail (EHOSTUNREACH); confirmed unaffected direction (node3/node2 as client to node1) works correctly at full/shaped speed as appropriate

evidence.requirement: Baseline unshaped throughput between node2 and node1 before shaping
evidence.summary: iperf3 bidir test measured ~44.6/50.1 Gbit/s between node2 and node1 with no shaping applied

evidence.requirement: tc shaping rules installed and applied on node1 (HTB egress class + ingress redirect to ifb0, both scoped to node2's IP)
evidence.summary: tc qdisc/class/filter output shows htb 1:10 rate/ceil 1Mbit for dst=node2, default 1Gbit class for everything else, plus ingress filter redirecting src=node2 to ifb0 with a 1Mbit HTB class

evidence.requirement: Measured demonstration of ~1 Mbit/s limit in each direction between node2 and node1
evidence.summary: iperf3 upload (node2->node1) measured 834 Kbit/s receiver; iperf3 reverse/download (node1->node2) measured 874 Kbit/s receiver, both close to the 1 Mbit/s target

evidence.requirement: Traffic from node1 to other hosts (not node2) stays unshaped
evidence.summary: iperf3 node3->node1 measured 77.0 Gbit/s, confirming node1's non-node2 traffic path is unaffected by the shaping filters which are scoped only to 10.100.149.11

evidence.requirement: Shaping persists across reboot (configured via /etc/rc.local, confirmed invoked at boot)
evidence.summary: Confirmed /etc/init.d/done (S95done) invokes /etc/rc.local at boot; wrote tc setup commands into /etc/rc.local for node1

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 4ae495d8 and healthy tc state; issued `reboot -d 2`; polled until boot_id changed to 4ed8b2df with uptime reset; verified tc qdisc/class/filter state was reapplied automatically post-boot and re-measured shaped throughput at 955 Kbit/s

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id f7db4b4e; issued `systemctl reboot`; polled until boot_id changed to 6bc36b69 with uptime reset; confirmed IP/network/iperf3 recovery and re-verified shaping still applies at 807 Kbit/s

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 45c22b1f; issued `systemctl reboot`; polled until boot_id changed to 20041b35 with uptime reset; confirmed IP/network/iperf3 recovery and re-verified node1<->node3 traffic remained unshaped at 77.3 Gbit/s

Demonstrated the limit with iperf3 transfers in both directions, made the shaping persistent via /etc/rc.local, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, verifying boot-identity change and post-restart recovery on each.
